questions.question: Verify the admission year and historical name of the normal school, the circumstances of expulsion and the evidence for the claim that royalists arranged the duel.

localizations.source: Verify the admission year and historical name of the normal school, the circumstances of expulsion and the evidence for the claim that royalists arranged the duel.
localizations.ru: Уточнить год поступления и историческое название нормальной школы, обстоятельства исключения и доказательную основу утверждения о дуэли, подстроенной роялистами.

questions.resolution: The school’s date and name, expulsion and disputed duel account were corrected.

questions.question: Agree the statement about equations above the fourth degree: should it explicitly refer to the general equation? Verify the historical attribution of the listed algebraic concepts and the completeness of Liouville’s 1846 publication.

localizations.source: Agree the statement about equations above the fourth degree: should it explicitly refer to the general equation? Verify the historical attribution of the listed algebraic concepts and the completeness of Liouville’s 1846 publication.
localizations.ru: Согласовать формулировку о неразрешимости уравнений выше четвёртой степени: следует ли явно говорить об общем уравнении. Уточнить историческую атрибуцию перечисленных алгебраических понятий и полноту публикации Лиувилля 1846 года.

questions.resolution: The statement now concerns the general equation; Galois’s concepts and Liouville’s publication are described more precisely.

questions.question: Distinguish the histories of Galois’s manuscripts involving Cauchy, Fourier and Poisson: Cauchy received a manuscript, Fourier died before reviewing the prize submission, and Poisson issued a negative report; saying that all three simply “failed to appreciate” the work conflates different events.

localizations.source: Distinguish the histories of Galois’s manuscripts involving Cauchy, Fourier and Poisson: Cauchy received a manuscript, Fourier died before reviewing the prize submission, and Poisson issued a negative report; saying that all three simply “failed to appreciate” the work conflates different events.
localizations.ru: Развести судьбу рукописей Галуа у Коши, Фурье и Пуассона: Коши получил рукопись, Фурье умер до рассмотрения конкурсной работы, Пуассон дал отрицательный отзыв; общая формула «не оценили» смешивает разные события.
